crm_notes:
Summary: CallScribe builds a voice-first QA and coaching layer for mid-market contact centers. Primary interest: automated post-call summaries (structured TL;DR, QA tags), coach highlight extraction (coaching clips + suggested talking points), and automated ticket creation via tool-calls to Zendesk/Salesforce. Wants high reliability during weekday business spikes (peak concurrency ~650, planning for headroom to 1k).

Key technical constraints: prefers VPC-backed deployment for Prod with private egress. Tight security checklist: SOC2 + KMS integration + audit logs + SSO/SAML. Must meet EU data residency for several enterprise clients. Prefers models that support function/tool calling to trigger CRM updates and to extract structured fields (disposition, NPS, escalation reason). Cost-sensitive: wants recommendations to minimize per-call token costs (batching/caching, quantization).

Recent interactions: short POC completed ingesting 1.2k post-call transcriptions (s3 upload). Redwood hosted API produced summaries that matched QA rubric for ~72% of calls; customer target 85% for pilot. SE Raj proposed a hybrid routing plan: small, high-quality model for QA + cheaper reranker for quick classification; fallback to smaller quantized variant under capacity stress.

Quotes & verbal notes: "We need coachable highlights that are clip-ready — timestamps + 3 bullets max" — Head of QA. "If Redwood can demonstrate stable throughput during our Monday ramp we can sign term commitment" — VP Ops.

POC deliverables: 1) run 10k calls through Dedicated pool for 2 weeks, 2) produce QA rubric report, 3) measure end-to-end latency for summary generation (target p95 < 2s for post-call batch, p50 < 350ms for in-call assist API), 4) show cost roadmap using Redwood Optimize recommendations.

Attachments & refs: fireflies-ff-37719 transcript for 2026-01-12 demo, drive:/deals/callscribe/rdw-security-faq-v2, drive:/deals/callscribe/poc-pricing-2026-02.pdf, jira INF-5234 (data ingestion schema bug).

Sales notes: high upside (multi-product deal: Optimize + Dedicated + Hosted for dev). Prod push contingent on security sign-off and a successful 2-week high-concurrency run. Keep pricing flexible — prefers annual commit if SLOs met.

Next actions (from last call): SE to deliver tuning plan + quantization matrix by 2026-03-05; Legal to share SOC2 cert; schedule 2-week Dedicated POC for April week 2.
